column1: # W53-A: paradigm-transfer control (tab:transfer) on the two missing Mind2Web splits.
# WHY. tab:transfer reports "Mind2Web (Step SR)" but every cell comes from
# mind2web_task alone, whereas Mind2Web's official metric pools three cross-splits
# by step count. The column label therefore overstates its scope. Running website
# and domain lets the table report the pooled Mind2Web number that the rest of the
# paper uses, so the transfer control and the main multi-step table become
# directly comparable instead of silently measuring different things.
# WHAT. Three published selectors ported onto the deletion-only path (nap_pubsel),
# plus their native re-prefill twins, at both budgets on both missing splits.
# Native rows use baseline_full so they keep the published pipeline (re-encode
# every frame, select per frame independently); ported rows use abc_r10 so the
# same scoring rule is executed inside our nested order. That contrast is the
# whole point of the control, so both halves must be present per split.
# ANCHORS. Every row is byte-identical to the adopted mind2web_task rows except
#   native  <- w52-style pub rows with GEOPACT_PUBBASE_CURRENT at the same c
# \method{} rows already exist for all three splits (xds8b_full), so they are not
